creed.name: Apostles' Creed
creed.text:
↑ I believe in God, the Father almighty,
↓ Creator of heaven and earth,
↑ and in Jesus Christ, his only Son, our Lord,
↓ who was conceived by the Holy Spirit,
↑ born of the Virgin Mary,
↓ suffered under Pontius Pilate,
↑ was crucified, died and was buried;
↓ he descended into hell;
↑ on the third day he rose again from the dead;
↓ he ascended into heaven,
↑ and is seated at the right hand of God the Father almighty;
↓ from there he will come to judge the living and the dead.

↑ I believe in the Holy Spirit,
↓ the holy catholic Church,
↑ the communion of saints,
↓ the forgiveness of sins,
↑ the resurrection of the body,
↓ and life everlasting.

✦ Amen.

our_father.name: Our Father
our_father.text:
↑ Our Father, who art in heaven,
↓ hallowed be thy name;

↑ thy kingdom come,
↓ thy will be done,
↑ on earth as it is in heaven.

↑ Give us this day our daily bread,
↓ and forgive us our trespasses,
↑ as we forgive those who trespass against us;

↓ and lead us not into temptation,
↑ but deliver us from evil.

✦ Amen.

hail_mary.name: Hail Mary
hail_mary.text:
↑ Hail Mary, full of grace,
↓ the Lord is with thee.
↑ Blessed art thou among women,
↓ and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.

↑ Holy Mary, Mother of God,
↓ pray for us sinners,
↑ now and at the hour of our death.

✦ Amen.

glory_be.name: Glory Be
glory_be.text:
↑ Glory be to the Father,
↓ and to the Son,
↑ and to the Holy Spirit;

↓ as it was in the beginning,
↑ is now,
↓ and ever shall be,
↑ world without end.

✦ Amen.

hail_holy_queen.name: Hail Holy Queen
hail_holy_queen.text:
↑ Hail, holy Queen, Mother of mercy,
↓ our life, our sweetness and our hope.

↑ To thee do we cry,
↓ poor banished children of Eve;
↑ to thee do we send up our sighs,
↓ mourning and weeping in this valley of tears.

↑ Turn, then, most gracious advocate,
↓ thine eyes of mercy toward us,
↑ and after this our exile
↓ show unto us the blessed fruit of thy womb, Jesus.

↑ O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary.

✦ Amen.

sign_of_cross.name: Sign of the Cross
sign_of_cross.text:
↑ In the name of the Father,
↓ and of the Son,
↑ and of the Holy Spirit.

✦ Amen.

mountain_prayer.name: Mountain, Hands at Heart
mountain_prayer.setup: Stand at the front of the mat, feet hip-width or together, weight even across both feet. Crown tall, shoulders soft. Palms together at the heart.
mountain_prayer.hold: The standing prayer. Press the feet down to stand taller. The breath moves; the body is still.

arm_floats.name: Breath-Led Arm Floats
arm_floats.setup: From Mountain: on each inhale line, float the arms out and overhead. On each exhale line, draw the palms back down through the heart. The prayer sets the tempo — rise on ↑ lines, return on ↓ lines.
arm_floats.hold: The first link of breath to movement. Slow arcs, soft shoulders. Nothing is rushed.

half_salutation.name: Half Salutation
half_salutation.setup: One half salutation per Hail Mary. Inhale, arms sweep overhead. Exhale, fold over the legs. Inhale, half lift — flat back. Exhale, fold again. Inhale, rise all the way up. Exhale, hands to heart on the Amen.
half_salutation.hold: Three rounds, one per bead. Each round rehearses the entrance and the exit of the full salutation.
half_salutation.target: Hamstrings wake, spine articulates, breath syncs

standing_crescent.name: Standing Crescent
standing_crescent.setup: From Mountain, inhale the arms overhead, then reach up and back into a gentle standing backbend — chest opening, gaze following the hands. Only as far as the low back stays easy.
standing_crescent.hold: A long crescent through the whole front body. Root down through the feet, lift up and over, and come back through center with control.

arms_up.name: Upward Salute
arms_up.setup: Inhale. The arms sweep wide and overhead, palms facing each other. Gaze follows the thumbs if the neck allows.
arms_up.hold: The whole front body reaches. Ribs soft, shoulders away from the ears. Rooted below, rising above.

standing_fold.name: Standing Forward Fold
standing_fold.setup: Exhale. Hinge at the hips and fold over the legs. Bend the knees as much as they need — let the belly rest toward the thighs. Head hangs heavy.
standing_fold.hold: Neck loose, jaw loose. Gravity does the work. With every exhale the fold deepens on its own.

half_lift.name: Half Lift
half_lift.setup: Inhale. Slide the hands up the shins and lengthen the spine forward — flat back, crown reaching ahead. Gaze slightly forward, not up.
half_lift.hold: A long line from tailbone to crown. This shape teaches the hinge that every fold and every rise passes through.

plank.name: Plank
plank.setup: Step back one leg at a time and lower onto the forearms — elbows under the shoulders, forearms flat, body one straight line from crown to heels. Press the floor away and reach the heels back. Knees down at any time — same line, less load.
plank.hold: Quietly hard work. Belly lifts, gaze down. If the low back sags, knees come down without apology.

cobra.name: Low Cobra
cobra.setup: Lower to the floor — knees, then chest, then chin. Hands under the shoulders, elbows in toward the ribs. Inhale and lift the chest forward and up, the arms helping as much as feels open — hips and legs stay heavy on the floor.
cobra.hold: Lift only as far as the back stays comfortable. The hips stay grounded and the low back never pinches. Shoulders melt away from the ears.

down_dog.name: Downward Dog
down_dog.setup: Tuck the toes and lift the hips up and back into a long upside-down V. Hands press the mat, knees bend as generously as the hamstrings ask. Heels reach down without needing to land.
down_dog.hold: The whole back body lengthens. Head hangs between the arms. Pedal the feet if it helps — then be still and breathe.

chair.name: Chair
chair.setup: Exhale, sit the hips back and down as if toward a chair, weight in the heels. Inhale the arms overhead in line with the torso.
chair.hold: The thighs burn quietly; that is the pose. Chest lifted, low back long, breath even.

warrior_1_right.name: Warrior I · Right
warrior_1_right.setup: From Downward Dog, step the right foot forward between the hands. Spin the back heel down, hips facing forward. Inhale the torso up, arms overhead. The front knee bends over the ankle.
warrior_1_right.hold: Grounded through both feet, rising through the arms — the old standing prayer, with the legs at work.

warrior_1_left.name: Warrior I · Left
warrior_1_left.setup: From Downward Dog, step the left foot forward between the hands. Spin the back heel down, hips facing forward. Inhale the torso up, arms overhead. The front knee bends over the ankle.
warrior_1_left.hold: Grounded through both feet, rising through the arms — the old standing prayer, with the legs at work.

vinyasa.name: Vinyasa
vinyasa.setup: On the first half of the prayer, flow: plank, lower with the knees down, low cobra, then press back to Downward Dog. On the second half, settle into the Dog and breathe.
vinyasa.hold: One moving breath-phrase, then stillness. Move with the words; rest with the words. Knees down is the default, not the exception.
vinyasa.target: The connecting flow of Salutation B

seated_forward_fold.name: Seated Forward Fold
seated_forward_fold.setup: Sit with legs extended. Bend the knees as much as you need. Fold forward from the hips. Let the head and shoulders hang heavy.
seated_forward_fold.hold: A long pull along the back of the legs and the spine. Soft. Never forced.
seated_forward_fold.target: Posterior chain — hamstrings, low back, spine

child_pose.name: Child's Pose
child_pose.setup: Kneel with big toes touching. Knees wide or together. Sink the hips toward the heels. Stretch the arms forward. Forehead rests on the mat.
child_pose.hold: Grounded, sheltered. The spine lengthens, the hips release, the breath slows.

supported_butterfly.name: Supported Butterfly
supported_butterfly.setup: Lie on your back. Soles of the feet together, knees fall open. Place a pillow or folded towel under each knee. Arms rest at the sides, palms up.
supported_butterfly.hold: An opening through the inner thighs and front of the hips. Heavy. Yielding.

banana.name: Reclined Side Stretch
banana.setup: On your back, arms overhead. Walk both feet and the upper body to one side so the body forms a long curve. Both shoulders and hips stay on the floor. Hold one side, then switch.
banana.hold: A long opening down the side of the body — ribs, waist, hip. The pose most sequences skip. Critical for the low back.

savasana.name: Savasana
savasana.setup: Lie flat. Legs fall open naturally. Arms slightly out from the body, palms up. Let everything be where it falls.
savasana.hold: The pause before the mysteries begin. Body held by the ground. Mind held by the breath.

knees_to_chest.name: Knees-to-Chest
knees_to_chest.setup: Lying on your back, draw both knees toward the chest. Hands on the shins or behind the thighs. Breathe.
knees_to_chest.hold: A gentle decompression of the low back. Returns the body to neutral between decades.

neutral_back.name: Neutral on Back
neutral_back.setup: Lie flat, legs extended, hands resting on the belly so you can feel the breath rise and fall.
neutral_back.hold: One minute. The Glory Be. Then the next mystery is announced.

figure_four.name: Reclined Figure-Four
figure_four.setup: Lie on the back. Cross one ankle over the opposite thigh. Draw the bottom thigh toward the chest, threading the hands behind it (or use a towel as a strap). Hold five Hail Marys per side.
figure_four.hold: A deep release through the outer hip and glute. The body's most common source of low-back stiffness lives here.

supported_bridge.name: Supported Bridge
supported_bridge.setup: Lie on the back, knees bent, feet flat. Lift the hips and slide a low block or folded towel under the sacrum — the bony plate above the tailbone, not the lower back. Use the lowest prop height that supports you. If you feel a pinch in the low back, slide the prop down toward the tailbone or remove it entirely.
supported_bridge.hold: An unwinding of the hip flexors. A quiet opening across the chest. The whole front body softens.

happy_baby.name: Happy Baby
happy_baby.setup: Lying on the back, draw the knees toward the chest. Grab the outside edges of the feet (or the shins, or behind the knees). Stack ankles over knees. Gently pull the knees toward the armpits.
happy_baby.hold: A childlike decompression of the lower back. A wide opening through the hips. Release the grip whenever it tires — the pose is the position, not the grip.

supported_fish.name: Supported Fish
supported_fish.setup: Place a folded blanket or low block lengthwise along the spine — short edge at the bottom tip of the shoulder blades. Lie back over it. Head rests on the floor or on a second, lower prop. Legs long, arms open. Keep the prop low — the neck should not strain.
supported_fish.hold: A passive opening across the chest and front of the shoulders. The upper back gently arches. If the low back grumbles, the prop is too low — move it higher.

legs_up_wall.name: Legs Up the Wall
legs_up_wall.setup: Sit close to a wall, hip touching it. Swing the legs up as you lower the back to the floor. The body forms an L. Hips flat or supported on a folded blanket. Arms open.
legs_up_wall.hold: The legs flush. The heart rate drops. The nervous system settles. The closing hold.

salutation.name: Morning Salutations
salutation.description: Sun Salutations A and B prayed on the beads. Standing, breath-led, for the start of the day.

opening.note: Lift into the backbend on the first half. Soften to center on the second.
opening.label: Opening · Glory Be
Opening · Threshold
opening.title: Threshold
opening.body:
Stand still. Eyes soft, or closed.

Four cycles of alternate-nostril breath.
Close the right nostril with the thumb. Inhale through the left.
Close the left nostril with the ring finger. Exhale through the right.
Inhale through the right. Close it.
Exhale through the left.

One cycle. Three more.
The mind gathers. The mysteries begin.

hail_marys.note: Step forward. Fold on the second half.

closing.label: Closing · Intention
closing.title: Intention
closing.body:
For whom is this morning's practice offered?

Hold them in mind.
Carry them into the day.

closing.label: Closing · Practice Complete
closing.title: Practice Complete
closing.body:
The body is warm. The mind is gathered.
Go meet the day.

restorative.name: Restorative Floor
restorative.description: Long passive holds on the floor. For hurt days, hard evenings, and travel.

opening.note: Hold the first side for one minute. Switch sides for the second.
opening.label: Opening · Glory Be · both sides
Opening · Threshold · Nadi Shodhana
opening.title: Threshold
opening.body:
Four cycles of alternate-nostril breath.

Close the right nostril with the thumb. Inhale through the left.
Close the left nostril with the ring finger. Exhale through the right.
Inhale through the right. Close it.
Exhale through the left.

One cycle. Repeat three more times.
Then rest. The body settles. The mind comes into balance.

closing.label: Closing · Intention
closing.title: Intention
closing.body:
For whom is this practice offered?

Hold them in mind.
Let the breath carry the offering.

closing.label: Closing · Practice Complete
closing.title: Practice Complete
closing.body:
Rest here as long as you wish.
When you are ready, roll to one side and rise slowly.

breath.name: Ujjayi
breath.description: Oceanic breath. Slow, full, audible at the back of the throat. Expansive. The throat is awake.

items.name: The Annunciation
items.reflection: Gabriel appears to Mary. The Word is offered.

items.name: The Visitation
items.reflection: Mary visits Elizabeth. The unborn John leaps in recognition.

items.name: The Nativity
items.reflection: Christ is born in Bethlehem. The world meets him as an infant.

items.name: The Presentation
items.reflection: The infant Christ is presented in the temple. Simeon prophesies.

items.name: The Finding in the Temple
items.reflection: The boy Christ, lost three days, is found teaching.

breath.name: Long exhale
breath.description: Short inhale through the nose. Long, slow exhale through the mouth. The breath receives. Lord, into Thy hands.

items.name: The Agony in the Garden
items.reflection: Christ prays in Gethsemane. The cup will not pass.

items.name: The Scourging at the Pillar
items.reflection: Pilate orders the scourging. The body is broken before the cross.

items.name: The Crowning with Thorns
items.reflection: The soldiers mock him. The crown of suffering is given.

items.name: The Carrying of the Cross
items.reflection: Christ bears the cross to Calvary. Simon helps. Veronica wipes his face.

items.name: The Crucifixion
items.reflection: Christ dies on the cross. The veil of the temple is torn.

breath.name: Victorious breath
breath.description: Full, deep inhale that opens the chest. Slow release. The breath of resurrection.

items.name: The Resurrection
items.reflection: Christ rises on the third day. The stone is rolled away.

items.name: The Ascension
items.reflection: Christ ascends to the Father.

items.name: The Descent of the Holy Spirit
items.reflection: Pentecost. The Spirit comes upon the apostles.

items.name: The Assumption
items.reflection: Mary is taken body and soul into heaven.

items.name: The Coronation of Mary
items.reflection: Mary is crowned Queen of Heaven.

breath.name: Nadi Shodhana
breath.description: Alternate-nostril breath. Inhale left, exhale right; inhale right, exhale left. Light entering both sides of the mind.

items.name: The Baptism of Jesus
items.reflection: In the Jordan. The Spirit descends as a dove.

items.name: The Wedding at Cana
items.reflection: Water becomes wine. The first sign.

items.name: The Proclamation of the Kingdom
items.reflection: Repent and believe the good news.

items.name: The Transfiguration
items.reflection: On the mountain. Christ shines.

items.name: The Institution of the Eucharist
items.reflection: At the Last Supper. Take and eat.

easy.name: Easy
easy.description: Body feels neutral or open today.

tender.name: Tender
tender.description: Some stiffness or mild ache. The practice softens — Salutation A only, knees down whenever you want.

hurt.name: Hurt
hurt.description: Sharp or persistent pain. Today is the floor practice — gentle holds only.
